title: Phase F B1 second thread used cumulative notifications
symptom: Attempt 2 ended DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN before its model turn
reproduction: Run the same R01 task after Attempt 1 fails its Check and B1 opens a second thread

evidence.detail: The second thread/start saw both the old and new thread/started notifications and rejected the count of two

root_cause: The concrete SDK port filtered the entire cumulative app-server transcript instead of only frames produced by the current thread/start request

considered_options.option: scope notification matching to a transcript offset
considered_options.reason: preserves persistent transport while binding each response to only its new frames

resolution: Capture the transcript length before thread/start and validate exactly one new matching thread/started notification after that offset
verification: Phase F SDK plus B1 target tests: 16 passed
Actual ChatGPT-auth two-thread zero-turn preflight created two distinct threads and zero model turns
